text: Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy
Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy
Most health insurance claims get rejected, so I shouldn't pay for a policy.

chain.why: It shows that only about 8% of health claims were rejected, contradicting the idea that most claims are turned down.
It shows that insurers decide cashless requests within an hour in about 87% of cases, indicating prompt claim handling.
It shows that the median cost of a private‑hospital stay is ₹24,000 out of pocket, a substantial expense without insurance.
It shows that only 44.3% of urban residents have any health insurance, meaning the majority lack coverage.

conclusion: Because claim rejections are low, processing is fast, hospital stays are costly, and many people remain uninsured, the belief that a personal health policy is unnecessary is not supported.
